name: CharXiv · chart understanding
scope: Scientific chart question performance. Descriptive and reasoning validation scores are separate; human/random references are labeled as in source. Released evaluations are historical (2024); current website scores are not imported. No paper chart images or question text included.

maintenance: Checked daily for updates within this exact selection. Source licenses and supported formats are checked before acceptance; blocked sources retain the last accepted snapshot. Historical and preliminary scope still applies.
changes: Selected numerical results; fields renamed and evaluation slices labeled. Original numerical scales retained. Questions, paper images, transcripts, contacts and trajectories excluded.
